items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I knocked the hell out of Kelly.

ctx.x: No, I don't know that, Waltz. Yeah.

For the love of might. It was a popular moment. It was one of those things like, I knocked the hell out of Kelly. You know, oh no, no. And I said, for the love of might, and my saxes went into the love of might. And I said to myself, talk about it, quick on the trigger, how did you do it? And my brother was my drummer and he was great. I'd never heard or played with a drummer like him. And he never presumed because of my mother. But I'd be standing in front of that band doing a chorus or something, you know, and…
And all of a sudden the band, I had no background.
